summary: Skyline Builders Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a Nasdaq ticker symbol change from SKBL to KAZR effective June 17, 2026, ahead of its pending business combination with Cove Kaz Capital Group LLC, a critical minerals development company. The transaction was signed on April 30, 2026, and is expected to close before year-end, subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. No financial terms, premium, or break fee were disclosed. Upon closing, the combined company will be named Kaz Resources Inc. and continue trading under KAZR. This is a de facto SPAC-like reverse merger where Skyline is the listed shell. What to watch: regulatory clearance and Form S-4 effectiveness timelines.
